Definition: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
BiblicalUsage: 1) gift, tribute, offering, present, oblation, sacrifice, meat offering; 1a) gift, present; 1b) tribute; 1c) offering (to God); 1d) grain offering
